notablePrerequisites: Bloodspore Thrinax has at least four +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Skirk Prospector by paying {R}.
Skirk Prospector enters the battlefield, triggering Paleoloth, returning Wild Cantor from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing itself, adding {R}.
Cast Wild Cantor by paying {R/G}.
Wild Cantor enters the battlefield, triggering Paleoloth, returning Skirk Prospector from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
